scope: Finite current isolation/access guard predicates; three UNSAT compatibility controls and three SAT nonvacuity witnesses. Guards are transcribed/reviewed premises, not Python/SQL source refinement or proof of native installation/authority.

results.name: current original guards have no shared native transaction profile
results.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun isolation () Int)
(declare-fun read_only () Bool)
(assert
 (let (($x12 (= isolation 2)))
 (let (($x10 (= isolation 1)))
 (let (($x8 (= isolation 0)))
 (or $x8 $x10 $x12)))))
(assert
 (let (($x8 (= isolation 0)))
(let (($x17 (and $x8 (not read_only))))
(let (($x15 (and (or (= isolation 1) (= isolation 2)) read_only)))
(and $x15 $x17)))))
(check-sat)

conclusion: Current profiles cannot compose in one transaction. Existing native component passes do not establish protected caller/source integration. A new admitted fresh fenced read profile or independently qualified fresh stronger-isolation source producer is required; no current guard is relaxed.
